title: Tele-PeriOP - Virtual preparation for surgery - avoiding unnecessary on-site visits through telemedicine and innovative expert systems
summary:
Over ten million operations are performed in Germany every year. Preparing for this requires several visits to the doctor to assess risks and inform patients. Digital solutions can make this process easier. 
In the planned TelePeriOP study, patients conduct the pre-operative information and medical history interview with an anaesthetist via video call using the telemedicine system tara. The certified clinical decision support system Medimir processes the data and supports the risk assessment. The planned multicentre, randomized study will test the effectiveness of this approach. Patients will be assigned to either the control group with conventional on-site appointments or the intervention group with telemedical information and decision support system.
conditions: Feasibility of preoperative anesthesiological patient information and consent

interventions.name: Intervention group: Preoperative anesthesiological patient information and consent is provided using the telemedical software system tara. In addition, clinical decision support and risk assessment are carried out using the clinical decision support system Medimir.
Control group: Preoperative anesthesiological patient information and consent as well as risk assessment are carried out according to the hospital's standard procedure with on-site appointments.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
ASA I to II, non-cardiac surgery with a focus on visceral surgery and at least one night inpatient stay, presence of a PC, laptop or tablet
Exclusion criteria:
Problems with hearing, vision, speech, language, care or limited legal capacity, complications from previous anesthesia  and/or existing anesthesia card (e.g. difficult airway, malignant hyperthermia), shortness of breath when climbing stairs of ≤ 2 floors, Cardiac diseases (myocardial infarction ≤ 12 months)
